name: 21770 · Monrovia, MD
findings: ZIP 21770 (Monrovia) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21770 (Monrovia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21770 (Monrovia) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
